news.body: ASK Automotive Limited ( NSE:ASKAUTOLTD ) came out with its yearly results last week, and we wanted to see how the...

news.title: Dividend increased to ₹1.85
news.body: Dividend of ₹1.85 is 23% higher than last year. Ex-date: 31st July 2026 Payment date: 5th September 2026 Dividend yield will be 0.4%, which is lower than the industry average of 0.6%. Sustainability & Growth Dividend is covered by earnings (12% earnings payout ratio) but the company has no free cash flows available, indicating it may be using cash reserves or debt to pay the dividend. The dividend has increased by an average of 22% per year over the past 2 years and payments have been stable during that time. EPS is expected to grow by 53% over the next 3 years, which should provide support to the dividend and adequate earnings cover.

news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS in line with analyst expectations despite revenue beat
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹15.08 (up from ₹12.56 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹42.0b (up 17% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹2.97b (up 20% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 7.1% (up from 6.9% in FY 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 2.5%. Earnings per share (EPS) were mostly in line with analyst estimates. Revenue is forecast to grow 9.6% p.a. on average during the next 2 years, compared to a 10% growth forecast for the Auto Components industry in India.

news.title: ASK Automotive Limited Recommends Final Dividend for the Financial Year 2025-26, Payable on or Before September 5, 2026
news.body:
ASK Automotive Limited announced that at the Board Meeting Held on May 19, 2026, recommended final dividend of INR 1.85 /- (92.5%) per equity share of the face value of INR 2/- per equity share of the Company for the
Financial Year 2025-26, subject To Approve the shareholders of the Company in the upcoming Annual General Meeting ("AGM"). Fixed July 31, 2026, as the Record Date for determining entitlement of Members to final dividend for the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026, pursuant to Regulation 42 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015. The dividend, if declared by shareholders at the AGM, shall be paid on or before September 5, 2026.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹4.05 (vs ₹3.34 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹4.05 (up from ₹3.34 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹10.8b (up 19% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹799.2m (up 21% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 7.4% (up from 7.2% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue is forecast to grow 13% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 10% growth forecast for the Auto Components industry in India.

news.title: ASKAUTOLTD: Upcoming Results Will Confirm Attractive Outlook At Current Levels
news.body: Analysts have kept their price target for ASK Automotive broadly steady at ₹599.6, reflecting only minor tweaks to assumptions such as the discount rate, revenue growth, profit margin and future P/E in their updated models. What's in the News ASK Automotive has scheduled a board meeting on January 28, 2026 to consider and approve unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and nine month period ended December 31, 2025 (company filing).

news.title: ASKAUTOLTD: Upcoming Results Review Will Support A More Optimistic Outlook
news.body: Analysts have lifted their price target on ASK Automotive from ₹565 to about ₹600, citing updated assumptions for revenue growth, profit margins, discount rate and future P/E that together suggest a different balance of risk and reward for the stock. What's in the News A board meeting is scheduled for October 30, 2025 to consider and approve unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2025 (company filing).

news.title: Chairman & MD recently sold ₹3.7b worth of stock
news.body: On the 25th of November, Kuldip Rathee sold around 8m shares on-market at roughly ₹472 per share. This transaction amounted to 12% of their direct individual holding at the time of the trade. This was the largest sale by an insider in the last 3 months. This was Kuldip's only on-market trade for the last 12 months.
